content.content: When `deccy log` cannot read every node, the deccy CLI shall refuse the invocation, naming the node that did not load.
content.rationale: log's set read is all-or-nothing — a partial set is not the set D16b fixes; refusing, and naming the node that did not load with the store's reason (S2-invalid), keeps log total over its read without re-deciding what a failure means.
